# HAND CLASSIFICATION of the core consumers
CORE design_sv_backN [Tools/ShippingDesignSVBack.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : depth 0: kidsPass_at hoc gives outsLeaf child (leaf_outs); depth m+1: kidsPass_at hoc gives outsAssigned child AND outsCheck C m child (textRun_outs, then the induction hypothesis)
  condition: induction on the UNIFORM depth n: a kid at remaining depth 0 needs outsLeaf, a kid at remaining depth >0 needs outsAssigned plus the same of its own kids
  class    : needs uniform depth AS WRITTEN. The per-kid conjunct (outsLeaf for a rank-0 kid, outsAssigned for a kid of rank>0, recursively over its instances) is what a per-module height supplies (houtsMod). A height-indexed restatement of design_sv_backN itself is the SRM6 HeightBridge (owner SRM6), not done here
CORE design_sv_unique [Tools/ShippingDesignSVBack.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : passes hoc twice to design_sv_backN
  condition: as design_sv_backN
  class    : needs uniform depth (inherited)
CORE design_sv_all [Tools/ShippingDesignSVBack.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : passes hoc to design_sv_unique
  condition: as design_sv_backN
  class    : needs uniform depth (inherited); consumed through the hoc binder of design_at_free
CORE design_at_free [Tools/ShippingShipsFree.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : binder hoc : Bnd raw D -> outsCheck (childMap D.modules) n (checkedOptimize b) = true, passed unopened to design_sv_all
  condition: uniform n (same n as designCheck)
  class    : needs uniform depth (inherited); SRM8 design_at_free_h keeps this binder
CORE ships_design_svN_all [Tools/ShippingShipsDesignSVAll.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : hypothesis outsCheck .. n .. = true -> ..., passed to design_sv_all
  condition: uniform n
  class    : needs uniform depth (inherited)
CORE ships_design_svH_all [Tools/ShippingShipsDesignSVAll.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : hypothesis outsCheck .. 0 .. = true -> ..., passed on
  condition: depth 0 only
  class    : needs uniform depth (depth 0; restatable trivially as houtsCheck for kids of rank 0)
CORE evalShipsHierH [Tools/ShippingPremiseEval.lean] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : computes the uniform Bool outsCheck as the report field uniqueCheck (decide)
  condition: uniform n
  class    : unclear (an evaluator, not a proof consumer; no soundness theorem uses it)
CORE textRun_outs [None] present_in_scan=True
  conjunct : outsAssigned m (a single-module fact; does not mention outsCheck)
  condition: none
  class    : restatable per module
CORE leaf_outs [None] present_in_scan=True
